title: Choose Lean
question: Three compositions in the existing HUD world. Same job: glance how far you are leaned, plus steer percent while riding. Spectate keeps lean and hides steer. The toy bike is out.

options.label: Horizon
options.thesis: The world tilts. Lean is a 2px horizon line and a huge signed degree — Delta Bar’s family, not a toy.
options.viewport: Wide plaque. Huge orange +32° on top. A white 2px horizon physically rolled 32° with L/R on the ends. Steer is a second 2px orange hairline and 30% under it.
options.risk: Can read as another Delta Bar if the tilt isn’t obvious at a glance.

options.label: Needle
options.thesis: A TV tach for roll: ticks, a fat orange needle, still type at the hub. The bike is the needle, not a silhouette.
options.viewport: Square plaque. Semicircle of ticks, thick orange needle at +32°. Huge still 32° under the hub. Steer hairline and 30% along the bottom.
options.risk: Closest to the rejected gauge if the needle gets thin or a bike sneaks back in.

options.label: Twin
options.thesis: Two numbers, one split. Lean and steer as Systems: huge type, thin tracks, no picture of a bike.
options.viewport: Portrait plaque, vertical hairline. Left: dim LEAN, huge orange 32°, thin white roll track. Right: dim STEER, huge white 30%, thin orange fill. Spectate drops the right column.
options.risk: Glance may require reading both numbers; the graphic of lean is weaker.
